deals.headline: Sportsology Capital Partners buys a minority stake in the Rangers
deals.summary: Sportsology's second deal and first in a major U.S. league, made from its debut fund (targeting about $500 million). Financial terms, sellers and the valuation were not announced; Cade Cunningham is among its athlete investors.

deals.evidence: to finance $500 million in debt on Globe Life Field
deals.headline: Arlington finances $500m of Globe Life Field
deals.summary: Arlington voters approved extending the half-cent sales tax, 2% hotel tax and 5% car rental tax for 30 more years to back $500 million of debt on Globe Life Field.

name: Texas Rangers
notes: Revenue, operating income and player expenses are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season; valuation is Forbes March 2026. The 2010 purchase by Rangers Baseball Express (Forbes: 'reported $593 million') predates 2015 and is not a deal row. Sportsology's stake size and the valuation were not disclosed. Ballpark Digest reports the Rangers secured $600 million of financing for the ballpark, but that article was not read, so it is not recorded. Not found: a named CEO (no CEO title on the front-office directory), registry entry for Rangers Baseball Express, attendance, kit supplier, jersey patch sponsor, socials.

ownership_summary: Owned by Rangers Baseball Express, the group that bought the club in August 2010 (reported $593 million), with Ray Davis as managing partner and majority owner. Sportsology Capital Partners, a sports private equity firm, bought a minority stake in February 2026 (terms undisclosed); NBA player Cade Cunningham invested through it.
